name: email-permitted-same-localpart-different-domain-valid
description: permittedSubtrees rfc822Name contains two full mailbox constraints with the same local-part but different host-parts. The leaf matches the first complete mailbox exactly, so the chain is valid. This catches permit-side implementations that key full-mailbox constraints only by local-part and let the later entry overwrite the earlier one.
references: Go #77952 - full-email constraint map keyed only by local-part
notes: email-excluded-same-localpart-different-domain-both-fire-invalid covers the excludedSubtrees direction. This is the symmetric permittedSubtrees case: losing foo@bar.example.com leaves only foo@baz.example.com and causes a false rejection.
